Food supply is a scam!! The guy who takes order or supply food to room is so arrogant that if you ask a plate he ask you to adjust with bowl. The look he gives if you request him anything, even tom cruise will shy!

Only good point the madam at reception is very helpful and proactive.

We checked in to the hotel at night as we missed the flight and then had the most horrific experience.
They had no drinking water, had to blinkit at night, no food to offer, had to order from zomato, no water in the basin or toilet, and got a bucket of water only. When asked for plates got to know no plates are available , got small paper plates instead. Dirty bedsheet, pillow cover, uncleaned washroom were add-ons.

Overall the most pathetic experience one can ever have after missing a flight.
Never ever stay in this hotel.
